what: F1 standalone review batch is not registered in the canonical larch-log batch table
scenario_or_breakage: log-phase.sh can accept review-findings-classification, but larch-log.sh write still rejects unknown batches through larch-log-batches.sh, so /review flat publishing fails before writing the TSV
suggested_fix: Add review-findings-classification .tsv replace none to scripts/larch-log-batches.sh, update scripts/larch-log-batches.md and scripts/test-larch-logs-batches.sh including .tsv as an allowed extension

what: F2 degraded voter columns cannot preserve missing slot positions
scenario_or_breakage: review-core compacts successful voter paths before passing --voter-files, so if slot 2 fails and slots 1 and 3 succeed, tally-code-votes.sh has no way to leave v2_* empty and put slot 3 in v3_* as the plan requires
suggested_fix: Extend the tally input contract to pass fixed slot metadata or placeholders for VOTER_1 through VOTER_3, then build classification columns from that fixed three-slot structure instead of the compact EFFECTIVE_VOTER_FILES list

what: F3 OOS_N votes are added to the prompt but left out of parse-rate detection
scenario_or_breakage: check_voter_parse_rate counts only ### FINDING_N headings, so an OOS-only or OOS-heavy ballot with narrative voter output can pass parse-rate as OK, reach tally as JUDGE_ERROR rows, and be rejected rather than retried or degraded consistently
suggested_fix: Expand the parse-rate heading extraction and diagnostics to include both FINDING_N and OOS_N, and add OOS_N coverage to the dispatch-code-voters retry tests

what: F4 0-judge classification TSV cannot be produced from the proposed per-block-loop-only site
scenario_or_breakage: the current 0-effective-voter path exits before the per-block loop, but the plan requires Fixture C to emit rows with empty axis columns and a FINDINGS_CLASSIFICATION_TSV_FILE KV
suggested_fix: Initialize and write findings-classification.tsv before the early exit, or factor TSV row generation into a helper invoked by both the 0-judge path and the normal voting path

what: F5 /review --diff --subagent will not return the classification artifact to the parent
scenario_or_breakage: the parent only parses heavy-worker SCOUT/YIELD KVs, and the heavy-worker contract only preserves those KVs, so Step 4 cannot log review-findings-classification after a subagent review run
suggested_fix: Update SKILL.md Step 0 and heavy-worker.md to preserve, return, parse, and log FINDINGS_CLASSIFICATION_TSV_FILE in the same way as YIELD_TSV_FILE

what: F6 lenient enum policy is internally contradictory
scenario_or_breakage: the tally section says missing or unrecognized rating tokens become empty axes with UNCERTAIN=true, while the edge-case section says unrecognized enum values are recorded raw, leaving parser and consumer behavior ambiguous
suggested_fix: Choose one contract for unrecognized enum values and make the prompt, parser call-site handling, TSV tests, and docs match that single rule
